DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_DIMENSIONAL_P: At combat start, add a [gold]Potion Satchel[/gold] to your Hand and gain 1 of each basic Principle. At the start of each turn, gain 1 of each basic Principle. Draw 2 additional cards on turn 1, then 1 additional card each turn.
It stores no bottles, only possibilities not yet chosen.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_FIRST_FORMULA: In each combat, the first Formula that successfully brews a Potion costs 1 less of its main Principle.
It does not choose a Formula for you. It only makes the first step less likely to lose its balance.
DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER_RELIC_POTION_SATCHE: One space kept for a use that has not arrived yet.
